normalization: Project IDs resolved to current-works; individual question IDs unique; blockers inherit source blocker IDs; no private file bytes

schedule_definition.confirmed: Only explicit engineer/PM authorized dated work, crew, location, readiness and source
schedule_definition.reported: Source captions are historical observations not planned tasks
schedule_definition.hold: Only recorded explicit task HOLD or admitted site HOLD; never infer stop from an unanswered question
schedule_definition.issue_age: Days since first recorded source observation, not hold duration
schedule_definition.overdue: Only if verified committed target date is present. Prior source targets shown as unverified.

question_definition.answers: Drafts in browser; user copies and posts to Slack; answers remain pending until source re-ingestion and engineer evidence admission
question_definition.engineering: MCQ answers not an engineering signoff
question_definition.resolution: Require responsible person, timestamp and supporting link, explicit resolution state

next_actions: Implement authenticated response capture adapter or Slack callback with stable question IDs
Import actual dated approved crew schedules from the scheduling-module authority rather than auto-promoting questions
Engineer verification and overdue policy to be separately approved
